title: Coupler.io Multi-Platform Integration
description: A client needed several business platforms connected to Coupler.io so reporting data could move without manual transfers. I configured the integrations, credentials and data flows, tested the connections and resolved issues along the way, leaving the client with a more reliable reporting workflow.

title: Travelgate FASTX API Integration & Hotel Amenities Mapping
description: A hotel-booking client was receiving supplier inventory and amenities in inconsistent formats. I worked on the FASTX integration and mapping layer, transforming supplier responses into a standardized structure so hotel facilities could be handled consistently across the booking platform.
workflow: Travelgate FASTX → Transform → Normalize → Booking Platform

title: Vapi AI Telephony Integration
description: A client already had a Vapi voice agent but needed a more flexible telephony setup. I connected the selected provider to the existing agent and integrated call events into the automation layer, creating a cleaner voice infrastructure for call handling and centralized event data.
workflow: Telephony → Vapi Agent → Call Events → Automation

title: Zoho Inventory API Integration
description: The client needed Zoho Inventory connected with their application so inventory information could move reliably between systems. I implemented and tested the API flow, handled the requests and responses, and resolved integration issues affecting the data exchange.
workflow: Application → Zoho Inventory API → Data Sync

title: API Endpoint Troubleshooting & Optimization
description: A client came to me with API endpoints causing problems between the frontend and backend. I traced the requests and responses, fixed the endpoint issues, and tested the communication flow to restore reliable application-to-API communication.

title: AI Lead Generation & Research Automation
description: A client was spending too much time manually finding and researching prospects. I built an n8n workflow that collected lead data, enriched and qualified prospects, used AI for company research, and organized the results for outreach. The repetitive research process became a single automated pipeline.
workflow: Lead Source → Enrichment → AI Research → Qualification → Outreach

title: AI Voice Agent & Appointment Automation
description: A client was losing opportunities because calls were missed and appointments were still handled manually. I built a voice workflow that handled calls, understood requests, qualified leads, checked availability, booked appointments and updated the CRM, creating a reliable lead-to-appointment process.

title: Website Scraping & AI Content Pipeline
description: A client had a time-consuming process for collecting website information and turning it into content. I built an n8n pipeline that scraped pages, cleaned and structured the data, used AI to generate content and passed the finished output to the required platform.
workflow: Web Scrape → Clean → AI Content → Publish

title: AI Social Media Content & Publishing Automation
description: A client was spending too much time managing content across social platforms. I built an n8n workflow that took content ideas, used AI to research and create posts, scheduled and published them, and recorded performance data so the publishing process could run consistently with much less manual work.
workflow: Idea → AI Research → Content → Schedule → Publish → Track

title: AI Email Outreach & Follow-Up Automation
description: A client’s sales team was spending too much time sending emails and manually following up. I built an n8n workflow that enriched leads, researched prospects with AI, personalized messages, sent multi-step sequences, tracked responses and updated the CRM automatically.
workflow: Lead → Enrichment → AI Research → Email → Follow-up → CRM

title: Real Estate Lead & CRM Automation
description: A real estate client was receiving leads from different sources and manually entering, qualifying and following up with each one. I built an n8n workflow that captured leads, enriched them, scored them with AI, routed them into the right pipeline and triggered follow-ups automatically.
workflow: Lead Source → Enrichment → AI Qualification → CRM → Follow-up

title: AI Customer Support & Knowledge Base/RAG
description: A client was dealing with repetitive customer questions and scattered support information. I built an n8n-based RAG workflow that classified incoming requests, retrieved relevant knowledge, generated responses and routed low-confidence cases to a human while logging the interactions.
workflow: Message → Intent → RAG Search → AI Response → Confidence → Handoff

title: AI Voice + GoHighLevel/WAVV Lead Management
description: A client was struggling with missed calls, slow follow-ups and manual GoHighLevel updates. I connected an AI voice agent with n8n, GoHighLevel and WAVV to capture conversations, transcribe and qualify leads, update the CRM and trigger follow-ups automatically.
workflow: Call → AI Voice → Qualification → GoHighLevel → WAVV → Follow-up

title: AI Virtual Assistant Automation
description: A client was spending hours handling repetitive requests, creating tasks, updating records and managing reminders across different tools. I built an AI virtual assistant using n8n and OpenAI that interpreted requests, looked up information, executed actions and kept connected systems updated.
workflow: Message → Intent → AI Assistant → Data → Task → Integrations → Reporting

title: AI Offer Generator Automation
description: A client was spending hours researching prospects and preparing tailored proposals. I built an n8n workflow that captured requirements, enriched the data, used AI to develop the offer, pulled relevant pricing and resources, generated the proposal, sent it and updated the CRM automatically.
workflow: Client Input → Enrichment → AI Strategy → Offer → Send → CRM → Tracking

title: Financial News Intelligence Pipeline
description: A client needed a faster way to track financial news from multiple sources. I built an n8n pipeline that collected articles through feeds and APIs, cleaned and processed the content, used AI to summarize sentiment and impact, stored structured intelligence and distributed alerts and reports.
workflow: News Sources → Extract → Clean → AI Analysis → Database → Alerts → Reports

title: AI Email Reply Automation
description: A client was spending too much time replying to repetitive emails. I built an n8n workflow that monitored incoming messages, filtered and categorized them, extracted relevant details and used AI to draft context-aware replies. High-confidence messages could be automated while complex emails went to human review.
workflow: Email → Filter → Extract → AI Reply → Confidence → Auto Reply / Review
